title: Penalty for Playing from the Wrong Spot After a Drop
question: If you drop your ball outside the relief area and then play it from there, what penalty do you receive?
explanation: There is a two-stroke penalty for playing a ball from the wrong place after a drop, according to the Rules of Golf.
imagePrompt: A teenage golfer, right-handed, addresses a ball lying clearly outside a yellow marked relief area on the fairway.
imageAlt: Teen golfer about to play a ball outside a marked relief area on the fairway.

issues: Yellow marking is a curved arc instead of a clearly defined shape for a relief area.
imageVerification.repairPrompt: Clarify the yellow marking as a realistic, closed, defined relief area boundary instead of a simple arc or curve.
